description: Wire up the merchant's email platform with their API key. 13 providers: mailchimp, activecampaign, kit (ConvertKit), getresponse, drip, mailerlite, klaviyo, brevo, beehiiv, loops, flodesk, hubspot (private-app token), emailoctopus. Credentials are validated live and stored encrypted; returns the account's audiences so you can pick one for follow-ups (audience meaning varies: Kit=tags, Drip=account, Beehiiv=publication, MailerLite=groups, Flodesk=segments, HubSpot=static lists). Only ActiveCampaign also needs api_url (e.g. https://youraccount.api-us1.com); every other provider needs api_key alone.
name: connect_email
title: Connect email provider
